newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares strong, CA sought.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares strong, CA sought.

text.p: Austrian shares closed at a new year high on Friday, buoyed by demand for shares in Creditanstalt and window dressing ahead of year-end, and traders forecast the upward trend would continue next week.
The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares closed 19.11 points up at 1,142.85, with 19 shares up and two down.
"The end of the year is close and there was an incentive among banks to get prices where they needed them," a trader said.
Creditanstalt preferred shares were the biggest gainer and second most actively traded as a finance ministry decision on reopening the bank's privatisation loomed.
Creditanstalt preferred jumped 32 schillings, or 6.98 percent, to 496.9 schillings on 67,362 lots. Ordinary shares also advanced 32 schillings to 733.
Some dealers traced the rise to investor interest from abroad but most said market makers were behind the move.
"Institutional investors don't want to touch Creditanstalt with a barge pole at the moment," a trader said.

Bank Austria preferred were the biggest decliner, slipping 0.74 percent to 403 schillings. Earlier the finance ministry confirmed it Austria had received a letter from the European Commission requesting details of the bank's bid for Creditanstalt.
ATX January futures finished 20.8 points at 1,149.8. The Vienna bourse index added on 5.41 points to 430.37. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
